{{Quote|If the ''Falcon'' is ready, we've ''got'' to leave this system at once!|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="DEII5" />}}
The '''Ganath system''' was a small<ref name="FF118">{{FactFile|118|LEI 49-50|Princess Leia Organa}}</ref> [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within [[Ganathan Space]] near the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]] in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ganath/Legends|Ganath]], which was hidden within the [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|Oktos Nebula]].
